artworks.title: "Jubilee Singers, Fisk University, Nashville, Tennessee"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of nine men and women posing for a formal photograph. Some individuals are seated, while others stand behind. The men have short, neatly styled hair and wear suits with bow ties or neckties. The women have their hair pulled back or styled elegantly and wear long dresses with high necklines and long sleeves. One woman seated holds a circular object in her lap. The background shows a plain wall and a draped curtain, creating a studio setting. Each person has a calm expression. The photograph is mounted on orange card stock.

artworks.title: University Singers of New Orleans
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The sepia-toned photograph shows a group of nine individuals arranged in three rows. All are visible from the waist up, dressed in formal Victorian attire. The men wear suits and ties, while the women wear dresses with high collars and ruffles. The men have various hairstyles, and the women's hair is elegantly styled. All have neutral expressions and are seated and standing in an orderly fashion. The background is a plain backdrop, with the names "University Singers of New Orleans" and "In Aid of Colored Orphans' Home of Louisiana" printed along the edges of the photo card.

artworks.title: "Bombproof Quarters of Major Strong at Dutch Gap, 16th New York Artillery"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an entrance to a dugout or shelter. It captures a wooden structure built into an earthen mound, with a doorway and a small window on the right side. In front of the shelter, there is a wooden ladder leaned against it, leading up the mound. The ground around the entrance appears to be barren with scattered twigs and debris. The image is a stereoscopic one, displaying double photographs side by side. It has an orange border with the text "THE WAR FOR THE UNION. PHOTOGRAPHIC HISTORY."

artworks.title: "Colored Pickets on Duty Near Dutch Gap"
artworks.artist: Brady's National Photographic Portrait Galleries, E. & H.T. Anthony
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals with rifles standing by the corner of a wooden building. One person is standing and aiming a rifle through a window of the building while the other is crouched and also aiming a rifle, using a large barrel for cover. The building is made of horizontal wooden planks with open windows, one of which has a wooden shutter. Debris and rocks are scattered around the base of the building, and there is a patch of dirt in the foreground. The image is framed in yellow with the text "Photographic History" and "The War for the Union."

artworks.title: "A Humble Home"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a rural homestead scene. The image depicts multiple wooden structures, likely homes or sheds, made of simple wooden planks with a rough texture. The roofs are slanted and covered with metal sheets or similar materials. In the background, there is a dense area of trees. In the foreground, there are several domestic animals such as a dog, chicken, and possibly a goat. The ground is dirt, with some tools or equipment scattered around.

artworks.title: "Old South Carolina Plantation"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with individuals gathered near simple buildings with thatched roofs. A group of people, both adults and children, are around an ox-drawn cart. The horizon is low in the picture, intersected by a row of buildings. In the background, leafless trees stretch toward the sky. The color palette is primarily sepia-toned.

artworks.title: "Digging Sweet Potatoes in South Carolina"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image is a sepia-toned stereoscopic photograph showing a group of seven individuals working in a field with their tools. The soil is turned where they are working, suggesting cultivation. The people are spread across the image, forming a staggered line. In the background, there is a line of trees separating the field from the sky. The color palette is dominated by soft browns and muted tones, enhancing the historical, rustic quality of the scene.

artworks.title: "Pendar, 115 Years Old"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman captured from the waist up, seated in a woven chair. She is positioned facing slightly to the left, with her hands clasped together on her lap. She has a gentle expression, with visible wrinkles and fine features. Her hair is covered by a head scarf or bonnet. Her attire consists of a buttoned dress with a capelet or shawl draped over her shoulders, and she is holding a white handkerchief. The background is plain and neutral, creating an intentional focus on her figure. The image is rendered in a sepia tone.

artworks.title: Street Scene
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men and boys standing around a wooden cart with American flags and fabric. The men wear suits, some with bowler hats or a top hat, while the boys are dressed in period clothing. A brick building with some signage is in the background, along a cobblestone road. Other individuals are standing and observing in the background.

artworks.title: "The Merry Bootblacks, Inauguration, Washington, DC"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a crowd scene in front of an architectural structure. The image shows a large group of individuals gathered on a cobblestone street. Behind them is a metal fence and a building with arched windows. There are also a couple of horse-drawn carriages surrounding the group. The photograph has a sepia tone and is in a stereoscopic format, likely dating back to the late 19th century. Text on the card indicates that this captures a notable occasion.

artworks.title: Singing for President Roosevelt, Pinehurst Tea Farm, Summerville, South Carolina
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a group of children and a few adults gathered outdoors. The children, dressed in formal attire typical of the early 1900s, are positioned with their backs to the viewer. They wear long socks, dark suits, and dresses. One girl in the foreground stands out with a light-colored dress and puffed sleeves. The children are standing closely together facing forward. Among the adults is a man elevated above the children, wearing a tall top hat and dark suit. The setting is outdoors, with tall trees and sparse bushes in the background, suggesting a park or forest area. The photograph is in sepia tone.

artworks.title: "A Rice Raft, South Carolina"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a group gathered on a pile of hay. The image shows a large group of individuals standing or sitting on a grassy bank in a rural landscape. The people are positioned in casual, relaxed poses. Sparse trees can be seen in the background. The photograph is in sepia tone.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright, with one hand resting on a nearby pedestal. She has a calm expression, well-defined facial features, and neatly styled hair. She is wearing a full-skirted dress with a plaid pattern and a fitted bodice. Around her are decorative elements, including draped greenery. The background is neutral with subtle texture.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing indoors. She is facing the camera, beside a tufted chair. The woman wears a voluminous dress with ruffles and a bonnet tied under her chin. She also wears a cape or shawl and holds a small object in her left hand. The background features a curtain with a tassel, a pedestal with a dish, and a carpeted floor.

artworks.title: Jennie
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image features a woman standing next to an ornate chair. She has a serene expression and medium-length hair. She is wearing a detailed, high-waisted dress and has her hand resting on the back of the chair. The background includes a balustrade and heavy drapery.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length view of a woman standing with her hand resting on a chair that has a fringed cover. She is positioned straight, facing the camera with a neutral expression. Her facial features include prominent eyes and a slight smile, and her hair is styled neatly under a small hat, which is adorned with a blue decoration. She is wearing a long, dark dress with a high collar and a belt at the waist embellished with a decorative buckle. The dress features a ruffled hem. A blue ribbon also adorns her collar. She has small earrings and is holding an object, possibly a handkerchief, in her hand. The setting includes a decorative curtain draping in the background, suggesting a studio portrait environment, with a plain wall and part of a wooden panel visible behind her. The photograph is presented within a sepia-toned cardboard frame.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated from the waist up, facing forward. He has one hand on his lap and the other slightly forward on a surface. The man has a clean-shaven face, short, neatly styled hair, and wears a formal outfit with a buttoned jacket, waistcoat, collared shirt, and bow tie. Accessories include a chain hanging from the waistcoat and a ring on his finger. The background is neutral, with a studio backdrop showing an interior scene. The photograph is framed with an ornate, gold-bordered matte.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman and Four Children
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five children. The central figure, a young boy, is standing behind a small ornate table, facing slightly towards one of the seated girls. He is wearing a dark suit with a buttoned jacket, a vest, and a shirt, with neat, short hair. To his left, a girl stands on the carpet with one arm resting on the table, wearing a light-colored dress with a striped sash and black boots. Her hair is curly and light in color. To his right, are two young girls seated on an upholstered chair. One girl has light-colored hair, styled with a bow, and wears a light dress with lace details, holding the other girl's hand. The other seated girl seems younger, with shorter curly hair and dressed similarly. A slightly older girl, with dark skin and hair styled in a middle part with bows, is sitting on the chair next to them, wearing a dark dress and a white apron. The background is simple, with the suggestion of a curtain on the left and a decorative window pattern on the right, and a plain floor beneath them.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a three-quarter length portrait. She is sitting in a relaxed position on a decorative chair, with her right arm resting on a small cushion on the armrest. Her left arm lies across her lap. The woman has a voluminous afro hairstyle and a composed expression. She wears a dress with floral patterns, lace details, and high lace-up boots. She is adorned with a bracelet on her right wrist. The backdrop is a textured surface, with the caption "Grier Bros., No. 906 Arch Street, Phila." at the bottom of the photograph.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image features a sepia-toned portrait showing the upper half of a young girl's body. She is posed facing slightly to the right, with her gaze directed away from the camera. Her hair is styled with neat curls cascading down the sides and bangs combed to the side. The girl is wearing a dark dress with a large white collar and a plaid bow at the neck. The background is off-white, with a decorative border surrounding the image. The mount at the bottom of the photograph identifies the studio as "Pifer & Becker, Wilshire Building, Cleveland, Ohio."

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up, standing with her hands resting on a large rock. She has curly hair, a high forehead, and wears a high-necked dress with embroidered sleeves. She also wears a necklace with a pendant. The background shows soft foliage, giving the impression of an outdoor setting. The photograph is in sepia tone.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a woman shown from the waist up. She stands facing the camera directly with her arms resting by her sides. Her facial features are clearly visible with a neutral expression. She has short hair neatly styled under a large decorative hat adorned with large fabric flowers and leaves. She is wearing a long-sleeved high-necked dress with structured shoulders, a fitted bodice, pleated design on the upper part, and a slim waistline. The dress is of a textured fabric in a dark color. She wears small earrings. The background is a simple textured backdrop, with the portrait enclosed in a decorative border. There is a photographer's mark that reads "Rhoads & Carte, Charlottesville, Va." at the bottom of the frame.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a formal pose with her body slightly angled to the side. She has a neutral expression and neat hair, wearing a long-sleeved dress with decorative details. She holds a rolled piece of paper in her right hand. The background depicts an artistic studio setting with painted elements including foliage, rocks, and an architectural balustrade, suggesting an outdoor scene.

artworks.title: Grace Hughes
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image displays an upper body profile of a young woman facing left. She has delicate facial features, well-defined eyebrows, and focused eyes. Her hair is dark and styled in an updo. She is wearing a high-necked dress with textured fabric, stripes, and floral embellishments on the shoulders. The background is plain, and the photograph is framed with a decorative border, with a mark indicating it was taken by Perkins in Baltimore.
